consequence.statement: After the upgrade, services protocol differentiation is on by default, but existing services without a protocol set are kept as they are to avoid connection disruptions. The agent only takes their protocol into account once they are deleted and recreated. Downgrading to a version without protocol differentiation makes the agent delete and recreate services that have a protocol set, which disrupts their connections.
consequence.remediation: To have the agent apply protocol differentiation to existing services, delete and recreate them after the upgrade. Before any downgrade, expect connection disruptions for services that have a protocol set. Use --bpf-lb-proto-diff to control the feature.

assertion.statement: Cilium 1.17 adds services protocol differentiation, on by default and controlled by --bpf-lb-proto-diff. Existing services without a protocol set are kept as they are and must be deleted and recreated before the agent takes their protocol into account. A downgrade disrupts connections for services that have a protocol set.
